title: In This Town — The Hourglass Guardian

scenes.line: In this town, we live inside a giant hourglass.
My whole family and everyone in town live inside.
Every twenty-four hours, our hourglass flips.
At the warning bell, we run to stone shelters.
Outside, a giant dragon guards us every day.
But one day, I dropped my bag and ran back.
The glass began to turn. I was trapped!
Sand poured down, and my family screamed.
The dragon cracked the glass and reached inside.
He lifted me out, just before the square disappeared.
He was never guarding the glass. He was guarding us.
